license_note: The Qwen RESEARCH LICENSE AGREEMENT (release date September 20, 2026) is a single LICENSE file, byte-identical in the Hugging Face repository and the GitHub repository. It grants use, reproduction, distribution, derivative works, and modification for non-commercial purposes only, defining Non-Commercial as research or evaluation purposes only, and requires a separate commercial license requested from Alibaba for any commercial use. Redistribution requires a copy of the agreement, change notices, and a Notice file; any model created, trained, or improved using the Materials or their outputs must display 'Built with Qwen' or 'Improved using Qwen'; derivatives may not use Qwen as their primary name. The grant terminates if the licensee sues over IP in the Materials, and Alibaba may terminate on breach. The text contains no separate acceptable-use policy or field-of-use list beyond the non-commercial limit and export-control compliance, and the agreement is governed by Chinese law with exclusive jurisdiction in the Hangzhou courts.

access_boundary: This record represents the Qwen-Image-2.1 open-weight release announced September 20, 2026 and served from the ungated Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 repository. The hosted qwen-image-2.1-pro API model on Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, the Qwen-Image 2.0 and 3.0 API lines, earlier open Qwen-Image checkpoints, the Comfy-Org repackaged weights, FlagRelease chip-specific builds, and community quantizations are separate boundaries.
strengths: The weights ship ungated as Safetensors on Hugging Face and ModelScope with the licence file beside them and in the GitHub repository
Day-0 documented paths through Diffusers, ComfyUI, vLLM-Omni, SGLang, and LightX2V, plus prebuilt FlagOS builds for eight non-NVIDIA chip platforms
tradeoffs: The licence permits only research or evaluation use, so any commercial deployment needs a separate license negotiated with Alibaba
No first-party hosted endpoint serves this exact checkpoint, since the Model Studio API model is the separate qwen-image-2.1-pro, and no third-party host is documented
